observation.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/cachetest && cd /workspace/backend && cat > /tmp/cachetest/Dockerfile1 <<'EOF'
FROM eclipse-temurin:25-jdk-alpine
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.gradle,sharing=locked \
    sh -c 'echo marker-abc123 > /root/.gradle/marker && cat /root/.gradle/marker'
EOF
cat > /tmp/cachetest/Dockerfile2 <<'EOF'
FROM eclipse-temurin:25-jdk-alpine
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.gradle,sharing=locked \
    sh -c 'ls -la /root/.gradle/ && cat /root/.gradle/marker'
EOF
echo "=== build 1 ==="; docker build --load -f /tmp/cachetest/Dockerfile1 . 2>&1 | tail -6
echo "=== build 2 (separate invocation, same context+target) ==="; docker build --load -f /tmp/cachetest/Dockerfile2 . 2>&1 | tail -8
